backlog.spec: Compute all rdkit.Chem.Descriptors.descList descriptors per molecule (TPSA, MolLogP, MolWt, HBD, HBA, RotBonds etc.), replace nan/inf with 0 and clip to +-1e6, and concatenate with the Morgan bits as RF input. Keep the RF settings.
backlog.title: Add RDKit 2D descriptors

backlog.spec: Use only RDKit descriptors (no fingerprint) with the RandomForest. BBB is largely driven by TPSA, logP, HBD and charge, so a low-dimension physchem set may generalize better across scaffolds. Clean nan/inf.
backlog.title: Descriptors only RF

backlog.spec: Replace the bit Morgan fingerprint with count-based Morgan (GetCountFingerprintAsNumPy, radius 2, 2048) fed to the RF.
backlog.title: Count Morgan fingerprints

backlog.spec: Swap RandomForest for ExtraTreesClassifier (500 trees, max_features 0.3) on concatenated RDKit descriptors and count Morgan features.
backlog.title: Descriptors + counts with ExtraTrees

backlog.spec: Replace RF with LGBMClassifier (n_estimators 400, learning_rate 0.03, num_leaves 15, colsample_bytree 0.3, subsample 0.8 with subsample_freq 1, min_child_samples 10, random_state seed, n_jobs 8) on RDKit descriptors plus Morgan counts of radius 2 with 1024 bits.
backlog.title: LightGBM on descriptors+FP

backlog.spec: Use CatBoostClassifier (iterations 600, depth 6, learning_rate 0.05, random_seed seed, verbose 0, thread_count 8) on RDKit descriptors plus MACCS keys.
backlog.title: CatBoost on descriptors

backlog.spec: Append the 167 MACCS keys (rdkit.Chem.MACCSkeys.GenMACCSKeys) to the Morgan bits and RDKit descriptors for the RF.
backlog.title: MACCS keys addition

backlog.spec: Use Morgan radius 1 with 1024 bits count fingerprints plus descriptors to reduce scaffold-specific bits; RF.
backlog.title: Smaller radius-1 Morgan with features

backlog.spec: Add hashed count atom-pair fingerprints (rdFingerprintGenerator.GetAtomPairGenerator, fpSize 1024) to the feature set alongside descriptors; RF.
backlog.title: Atom-pair and torsion counts

backlog.spec: Use Morgan generator with atomInvariantsGenerator=GetMorganFeatureAtomInvGen() (functional-class fingerprints), radius 3, 2048 counts, combined with descriptors; RF.
backlog.title: Feature-based Morgan (FCFP)

backlog.spec: Set MIN_SAMPLES_LEAF=2 and N_TREES=500, with class_weight='balanced_subsample'; keep the rest the same.
backlog.title: RF min_samples_leaf tuning

backlog.spec: Set MAX_FEATURES='sqrt' and N_TREES=500 on the current features, to decorrelate trees.
backlog.title: RF max_features sqrt

backlog.spec: Train an RF and a LightGBM on descriptors+Morgan counts; return the average of their rank-normalized (scipy.stats.rankdata) test predictions, which suits AUROC.
backlog.title: Rank-average ensemble RF + LGBM

backlog.spec: Use a StandardScaler on clipped RDKit descriptors, then LogisticRegression (C=0.1, max_iter 2000). Blend 50/50 by rank with the RF.
backlog.title: Logistic regression on scaled descriptors

backlog.spec: Standardize clipped descriptors (QuantileTransformer to normal), fit SVC(probability=True, C=1, gamma='scale') with random_state seed; return the probability.
backlog.title: SVM RBF on descriptors

backlog.spec: Precompute the Tanimoto kernel on Morgan count/bit fingerprints (minmax kernel), SVC(kernel='precomputed', C=1, probability=True). Test kernel against the train set.
backlog.title: Tanimoto-kernel SVM

backlog.spec: Average predictions of 3 RF models with different random_state derived from seed and different Morgan radius (1,2,3), on features including descriptors.
backlog.title: Seed-bagged ensemble

backlog.spec: XGBClassifier (n_estimators 500, max_depth 4, learning_rate 0.03, subsample 0.8, colsample_bytree 0.4, n_jobs 8, random_state seed) on descriptors+MACCS.
backlog.title: XGBoost with physchem and MACCS

backlog.spec: Hand-pick features: TPSA, MolLogP, MolWt, NumHDonors, NumHAcceptors, NumRotatableBonds, formal charge, count of basic amines, carboxylic acids, aromatic rings, fraction sp3, and halogen count. Fit gradient boosting (HistGradientBoostingClassifier, max_depth 3, lr 0.05, 200 iters).
backlog.title: Custom compact physchem features

backlog.spec: Add SMARTS-count features for carboxylic acid, tertiary/secondary amine, quaternary N, sulfonamide, and phenol to descriptors; RF or ExtraTrees. These strongly relate to BBB penetration.
backlog.title: Acid/base substructure flags

backlog.spec: Before featurization, keep the largest fragment (rdMolStandardize.LargestFragmentChooser) and neutralize charges (Uncharger), to remove salts; then Morgan + descriptors with the RF.
backlog.title: Canonical largest fragment, desalting

backlog.spec: Drop fingerprint bits with fewer than 5 active training molecules (use train-fold counts only) before fitting the RF with descriptors.
backlog.title: Feature selection by variance

backlog.spec: Out-of-fold (inner 5-fold, seeded) predictions from RF, LGBM and SVM on descriptors+FP, meta-learner LogisticRegression; predict the test set with base models refit on all training data.
backlog.title: Stacking with logistic meta

backlog.spec: Use LGBMClassifier with is_unbalance True, extra_trees True, num_leaves 8, 500 estimators, lr 0.03 on descriptors; reduces overfitting to scaffolds.
backlog.title: Balanced class weighting in LGBM

backlog.spec: Add rdkit.Chem.rdMolDescriptors.MQNs_ (42 molecular quantum numbers) and CalcNumAmideBonds etc. to descriptors and Morgan counts; RF.
backlog.title: Gasteiger charge/ MQN features

backlog.spec: Use RF with max_samples=0.7 and bootstrap True, 600 trees, min_samples_leaf 1, on descriptors+counts to add diversity.
backlog.title: Random-forest with scaffold-grouped OOB-free bagging

backlog.spec: Add Gobbi 2D pharmacophore fingerprint (rdkit.Chem.Pharm2D.Generate with Gobbi_Pharm2D.factory), folded to 2048 bits, plus descriptors; RF.
backlog.title: Pharmacophore 2D fingerprint

backlog.spec: ExtraTreesClassifier with 1000 trees, max_features 0.5, min_samples_leaf 2, on cleaned RDKit descriptors only.
backlog.title: ExtraTrees on descriptors only, many trees

backlog.spec: sklearn MLPClassifier (hidden 256,64, alpha 1e-2, early_stopping True, random_state seed) on quantile-transformed descriptors; average 5 seeds and blend by rank with RF.
backlog.title: Small MLP on quantile-scaled features

backlog.spec: In featurize(), compute RDKit MACCSkeys.GenMACCSKeys(mol) for each molecule (from rdkit.Chem import MACCSkeys), convert to a numpy array of 167 bits, and hstack it to the existing descriptors+Gobbi matrix. Leave the RF+MLP rank blend unchanged.
backlog.title: Add MACCS keys to features

backlog.spec: After the RF and MLP, fit sklearn SVC(kernel='rbf', C=1.0, gamma='scale', probability=False) on the quantile-transformed features Qtr, take decision_function on Qte, rank-normalize it, and blend equally: (rank_rf + rank_mlp + rank_svc)/3. Keep everything else unchanged.
backlog.title: Add SVC (RBF) as third blend member

backlog.spec: Add Morgan count features: use rdFingerprintGenerator.GetMorganGenerator(radius=2, fpSize=1024) and GetCountFingerprintAsNumPy(mol) per molecule, apply log1p, and hstack to the existing feature matrix in featurize(). Rest unchanged.
backlog.title: Count Morgan fingerprint folded to 1024

backlog.spec: Replace RandomForestClassifier with ExtraTreesClassifier(n_estimators=500, max_features=0.3, min_samples_leaf=1, n_jobs=8, random_state=seed) in the blend with the MLP. Keep the rank averaging.
backlog.title: ExtraTrees replaces RF

backlog.spec: Change MLP ensemble to 10 members with hidden_layer_sizes=(512,128), alpha=1e-1, and different seeds, early_stopping=True. Average probabilities as now. Optionally also add Gaussian noise-free dropout-like effect via max_features untouched. Check runtime stays under 10 minutes.
backlog.title: Wider MLP ensemble with stronger regularization

backlog.spec: After featurize, drop columns with zero variance on the training set and columns whose Gobbi bit is on in fewer than 5 training molecules (apply the same column mask to test). Compute the mask in fit_predict from Xtr only. Reduces noise for both RF and MLP.
backlog.title: Variance and correlation feature filtering

backlog.spec: Add CatBoostClassifier(iterations=600, depth=6, learning_rate=0.05, random_seed=seed, verbose=0, thread_count=8) fit on the raw Xtr (descriptors+Gobbi). Rank its predicted probabilities and blend equally with RF and MLP ranks (1/3 each).
backlog.title: CatBoost as third blend member

backlog.spec: Inside fit_predict, run a 4-fold StratifiedKFold on the training data to get out-of-fold predictions for RF and MLP (one MLP seed to save time), then fit a LogisticRegression on the two OOF rank-transformed predictions and use its coefficients to weight the final blend of test predictions. Watch runtime; reduce n_estimators to 200 for inner folds if needed.
backlog.title: Stacked blend weights via inner scaffold-free CV

backlog.spec: In featurize(), append rdMolDescriptors.MQNs_(mol) (42 integers) and a few Gasteiger-based stats (after AllChem.ComputeGasteigerCharges: max, min, sum of abs charges, and polar-atom charge sum) to the descriptors. Guard NaN with nan_to_num. Rest unchanged.
backlog.title: Add Gasteiger charge and MQN features

backlog.spec: Replace the MLP's hard labels by training MLPRegressor (same architecture, alpha=1e-2, early_stopping) on smoothed targets y*0.9+0.05, using predict() as the score for the rank blend instead of predict_proba. Keep the RF unchanged. Tests whether regression-style fitting is better calibrated for AUROC.
backlog.title: Label smoothing via soft targets for MLP

backlog.spec: In featurize, compute RDKit MACCSkeys.GenMACCSKeys(mol) for each molecule (167 bits, convert to numpy array) and hstack them with the descriptors and Gobbi bits. Leave the rest of fit_predict unchanged. Import with from rdkit.Chem import MACCSkeys.
backlog.title: Add MACCS keys to features

backlog.spec: Add an ExtraTreesClassifier (500 trees, max_features=0.3, min_samples_leaf=1, n_jobs=8, random_state=seed) trained on the same raw features Xtr. Rank-normalize its probabilities and blend with weights 1/3 each with the RF and MLP ranks (instead of 0.5/0.5).
backlog.title: ExtraTrees added to the blend

backlog.spec: Change the MLP to 10 seeds (random_state=seed+i), hidden_layer_sizes=(512,128), alpha=0.1, early_stopping=True with validation_fraction=0.15 and n_iter_no_change=15. Average the probabilities over seeds as before. Keep the RF unchanged. Watch runtime.
backlog.title: Wider MLP ensemble with larger weight decay and dropout-like regularization

backlog.spec: Append a small set of hand-made features to featurize: counts of carboxylic acid, sulfonamide, tetrazole, basic aliphatic amine (tertiary/secondary), quaternary N, phenol, and amide via SMARTS patterns with mol.GetSubstructMatches; plus TPSA/MW, HBD+HBA, and a flag for CNS MPO-like rules (TPSA<90, MW<450, HBD<=3). Stack with existing features.
backlog.title: Acid/base and BBB-rule substructure features

backlog.spec: For the MLP members, replace the hard classification with sklearn MLPRegressor (same architecture, alpha=1e-2, early_stopping) trained on smoothed targets y*0.9+0.05, output clipped to [0,1] and used in the rank blend. Average over 5 seeds. RF unchanged.
backlog.title: Soft-label MLP via label smoothing

backlog.spec: Compute Morgan count fingerprints (radius 2, 2048 bits) as dense arrays for train and test, build the min-max (generalized Tanimoto) kernel matrices manually with numpy, fit SVC(kernel='precomputed', C=1, probability=False) and use decision_function, rank-normalized. Add as a third member with weight 1/3 each in the rank blend.
backlog.title: Tanimoto-kernel SVM on Morgan counts as blend member

backlog.spec: Add rdkit.Chem.rdMolDescriptors.MQNs_(mol) (42 values) and partial-charge summary statistics (max, min, sum of abs, after AllChem.ComputeGasteigerCharges, nan-to-zero) to the feature matrix in featurize.
backlog.title: Gasteiger charge and MQN features

backlog.spec: Within fit_predict compute the Murcko scaffold of each training molecule and weight each sample by 1/sqrt(count of its scaffold in the training set), normalized to mean 1. Pass as sample_weight to the RF fit; for the MLP, instead resample the training set with those weights (np.random.RandomState(seed).choice with replacement, same size) before fitting each MLP seed. This reduces over-representation of common scaffolds, matching scaffold-split evaluation.
backlog.title: Sample weighting by scaffold cluster size

backlog.spec: Inside fit_predict, run a 5-fold StratifiedKFold(seed) on the training set to get out-of-fold RF and MLP probabilities (use 3 MLP seeds for speed), fit LogisticRegression on logit of these two columns, then fit full RF/MLP and apply the meta-learner to test predictions instead of fixed 0.5/0.5 rank averaging. Check runtime stays under 10 minutes; reduce RF trees to 200 if needed.
backlog.title: Stacking with logistic meta-learner on inner out-of-fold predictions

backlog.spec: Slot 18 (ExtraTrees 1000 trees, max_features 0.5, replacing RF in the RF+MLP blend) gave 0.0890, the best so far but marked reject. Re-run it as the new base with min_samples_leaf=2 and max_features=0.4. Keep the rank blend 0.5/0.5 with the 5-seed MLP. This checks whether the gain is real and tunes it slightly.
backlog.title: ExtraTrees plus MLP, replicate and tune

backlog.spec: In the MLP part of the blend, train MLPClassifier on duplicated data with sample weights instead of hard labels. Concretely, stack Xtr twice with labels 1 and 0, with weights 0.9 and 0.1 for positives and 0.1 and 0.9 for negatives (smoothing eps=0.1). Everything else stays the same. This regularizes the MLP's overconfident outputs.
backlog.title: Soft-label MLP via label smoothing

backlog.spec: Compute the Murcko scaffold of each training molecule. Weight each sample by 1/sqrt(size of its scaffold group), normalized to mean 1. Pass the weights as sample_weight to the RF. The MLP is unchanged because sklearn's MLPClassifier has no sample_weight. This down-weights over-represented chemical series so the model generalizes better to unseen scaffolds.
backlog.title: Scaffold-cluster sample weights

backlog.spec: Add the 167 MACCS keys (rdkit.Chem.MACCSkeys.GenMACCSKeys) as extra columns, hstacked onto the descriptors and the Gobbi bits. Both RF and MLP use them. This is cheap and adds known substructure signals relevant to BBB penetration.
backlog.title: MACCS keys appended to features

backlog.spec: Append hand-made features: the number of acidic groups (carboxylic acid, tetrazole, sulfonic acid, acyl sulfonamide via SMARTS), the number of basic amines (aliphatic tertiary, secondary, primary amines), the number of H-bond donors, TPSA, MW, and the CNS MPO-style combinations: TPSA/MW, a flag for HBD<=3, a flag for TPSA<90, and a flag for MW<450. Append them to the existing matrix. The MLP gets them after the quantile transform too.
backlog.title: BBB rule-based compact features

backlog.spec: Add CatBoostClassifier(iterations=600, depth=6, learning_rate=0.05, l2_leaf_reg=5, random_seed=seed, verbose=0, thread_count=8) trained on the descriptor matrix only (no pharmacophore bits, to keep it fast). Rank-normalize its probabilities and average with the RF and MLP at weights 1/3 each.
backlog.title: CatBoost third blend member

backlog.spec: After featurizing, compute on the training fold the columns with zero variance and the columns with absolute Pearson correlation >0.95 to an earlier column. Drop them from both train and test before the RF and the quantile transform and MLP. This reduces redundant inputs and may help the MLP and the max_features sampling.
backlog.title: Dropped-descriptor correlation filter

backlog.spec: Replace the 5 identical-shape MLPs with 6 MLPs that cycle through hidden sizes (256,64), (128,), (512,128) and alpha values 1e-2, 1e-1, 1. Use the same quantile inputs. Keep max_iter=200 and early_stopping=True. Average the probabilities as before. Keep the total runtime moderate. This adds diversity and regularization.
backlog.title: Diverse MLP ensemble with varied architectures

backlog.spec: For the MLP only, augment the quantile-normal training matrix Qtr with 2 extra copies, each with Gaussian noise (sd 0.2) added using np.random.RandomState(seed), and with the same labels. Train each of the MLPs on the 3x data. This is a bold regularization that smooths the decision surface. The RF is unchanged.
backlog.title: Gaussian noise augmentation for MLP inputs

backlog.spec: In fit_predict, replace RandomForestClassifier with ExtraTreesClassifier(n_estimators=1000, max_features=0.5, min_samples_leaf=1, n_jobs=8, random_state=seed), keeping the MLP blend and rank averaging unchanged. This replicates the best earlier result (0.0890) to check it is real. Import ExtraTreesClassifier from sklearn.ensemble.
backlog.title: Replicate ExtraTrees replacing RF

backlog.spec: Replace the 5 identical-architecture MLPs with 6 MLPs cycling through hidden_layer_sizes (256,64), (512,), (128,128), (256,128,32) and alpha in {1e-3,1e-2,1e-1}, each with a different random_state. Keep early_stopping=True and the average of predicted probabilities. Keep runtime under 10 min.
backlog.title: Diverse MLP ensemble

backlog.spec: Replace MLPClassifier with MLPRegressor trained on smoothed targets (y*0.9+0.05) on the quantile-normal features, 5 seeds, early_stopping=True, alpha=1e-2, and use its raw predictions for the rank blend. This gives a label-smoothing effect and a different loss from the classifier.
backlog.title: Soft-label MLP via regression

backlog.spec: Append a small hand-built block to the descriptor matrix: counts of carboxylic acids, basic amines (primary, secondary, tertiary aliphatic), quaternary N, sulfonamides, and phenols via SMARTS, plus TPSA/MW, HBD+HBA, the rotatable bond count and a CNS MPO-like score. Compute it per molecule in featurize and hstack it. This gives the trees and MLP direct acid/base signals.
backlog.title: Compact BBB rule features

backlog.spec: In fit_predict, after featurizing, drop the descriptor columns with zero variance on the train set or with absolute Pearson correlation >0.95 with an earlier kept column (computed on train descriptors only). Apply the same column mask to the test set before RF and MLP. The pharmacophore bits are left alone.
backlog.title: Correlation filter on descriptors

backlog.spec: Change the final blend from 0.5/0.5 to 0.35 RF / 0.65 MLP, and raise the MLP ensemble to 8 seeds if runtime allows. The MLP contributed a lot of the earlier gain, and the blend weight has never been tuned.
backlog.title: Rank-blend weight tilt toward MLP

backlog.spec: After the first blend, take the test molecules with the most confident blended rank (top 15% and bottom 15%), add them to the training set with the pseudo-labels 1 and 0, refit the RF and MLP on the enlarged set, and return the new blend for all test molecules. Use the same seeds. This is a bold transductive step to adapt to unseen scaffolds. Watch the runtime.
backlog.title: Pseudo-label self-training with test molecules

backlog.spec: Train each of the 5 MLPs on a different bootstrap resample of the training rows (rng seeded with seed+i) instead of the full set. The ensemble gets more diversity and acts like bagging. Keep the other MLP settings and average the predicted probabilities.
backlog.title: Bagged MLP on bootstrap resamples

backlog.spec: Use ExtraTrees (1000 trees, max_features 0.5) in place of RF. Feed the tree model descriptors plus Gobbi bits as now, but feed the MLP only the quantile-transformed descriptors (no Gobbi bits). This gives the two members different views of the data.
backlog.title: ExtraTrees plus no-Gobbi MLP features

backlog.spec: Replace the 5 identical-shape MLPs with 6 MLPs that cycle through hidden_layer_sizes (256,64), (128,), (512,128) and alpha values 1e-3, 1e-2, 1e-1. Each uses a different seed. Average their probabilities, then rank-blend with the tree model as before. Keep total runtime low by using max_iter=150.
backlog.title: Diverse MLP ensemble

backlog.spec: Replace the MLPClassifier with MLPRegressor (same layers, early_stopping, 5 seeds) fitted on smoothed targets 0.05 + 0.9*y. Use its predict output as the score in the rank blend. This gives smoother, less overconfident outputs from the MLP.
backlog.title: Soft-label MLP via label smoothing

backlog.spec: Train each of the 8 MLPs on a bootstrap resample of the training rows, drawn with np.random.RandomState(seed+i). Use a smaller alpha of 1e-3 and keep early stopping. Average the probabilities. This adds diversity to the ensemble through the data rather than only the init.
backlog.title: Bagged MLP on bootstrap resamples

backlog.spec: Compute the Murcko scaffold of each training molecule and its cluster size. Pass sample_weight = 1/sqrt(cluster size) (normalized to mean 1) to the RF fit. This down-weights the over-represented chemical series so the model generalizes better to unseen scaffolds. The MLP stays unweighted.
backlog.title: Scaffold-cluster sample weights for the trees

backlog.spec: After featurizing, drop descriptor columns (not Gobbi bits) with zero variance on the training set. Then drop one column of every pair with absolute Pearson correlation above 0.95, using the train-fold statistics. Apply the same column mask to the test set. Use the filtered matrix for both the RF and the MLP.
backlog.title: Correlation filter on descriptors

backlog.spec: Fit the current RF+MLP blend once. Take the test molecules with blend score above 0.9 or below 0.1 as confident pseudo-labels. Add them to the training set with hard labels and refit both models. Return the final blend predictions. Use only the test SMILES that fit_predict already receives.
backlog.title: Pseudo-label self-training

backlog.spec: Replace the single RF with an average of two forests: one with max_features='sqrt' and min_samples_leaf=1, and one with max_features=0.3 and min_samples_leaf=3. Use 300 trees each and average their probabilities before ranking. Everything else is unchanged. Keep the runtime under 10 minutes.
backlog.title: Feature-bagged RF ensemble with sqrt features

backlog.spec: For the MLP only, reduce the quantile-transformed matrix with TruncatedSVD to 128 components, fitted on the training set, and concatenate the 128 components with the quantile-transformed descriptor columns only (without the Gobbi bits). Keep the RF on the raw features. This gives the MLP a compact input that is less noisy than the sparse pharmacophore bits.
backlog.title: Kernel-PCA-free SVD-compressed MLP input

backlog.spec: In fit_predict, replace RandomForestClassifier with ExtraTreesClassifier(n_estimators=1000, max_features=0.5, min_samples_leaf=1, n_jobs=8, random_state=seed) on descriptors+Gobbi features, keeping the 5-seed MLP and 50/50 rank blend unchanged. Purpose is a clean replicate of the earlier 0.0890 result. Keep runtime under 10 minutes.
backlog.title: Replicate ExtraTrees replacing RF

backlog.spec: Replace the MLPClassifier members with MLPRegressor (same layers (256,64), alpha 1e-2, early_stopping, 5 seeds) trained on soft targets y*0.9+0.05 using the quantile-normal features. Use the predicted values directly for rank averaging with the RF. This changes the loss to squared error, giving softer, better-ranked outputs.
backlog.title: Label-smoothed MLP via regression

backlog.spec: For each of the 8 MLP members, train on a bootstrap resample of training rows (rng seeded from seed+i) instead of the full set, using the same architecture and settings. Average probabilities, then rank-blend with the RF as before. This adds diversity through bagging.
backlog.title: Bootstrap-bagged MLPs

backlog.spec: Train 10 MLPs, each on a random 60% subset of the quantile-transformed columns (chosen with np.random.RandomState(seed+i)). Average their probabilities, then rank-blend with the RF 50/50. Random subspaces give diversity and reduce overfitting to the wide sparse Gobbi bits.
backlog.title: Feature-bagged MLP subspaces

backlog.spec: For the MLP branch only, apply TruncatedSVD or PCA with 128 components to the quantile-normal matrix (fit on the train fold), then train the 5-seed MLP on the compressed features, with hidden layers (128,32) and alpha 1e-2. The RF keeps raw features. Rank-blend 50/50.
backlog.title: SVD-compressed MLP input

backlog.spec: Replace the single RF with RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=1000, max_features='sqrt', min_samples_leaf=1, n_jobs=8), and keep the MLP blend. The lower feature fraction gives more decorrelated trees on the wide features and also runs faster.
backlog.title: Multi-seed RF with sqrt features

backlog.spec: Change the MLP to solver='adam', learning_rate_init=3e-4, batch_size=64, n_iter_no_change=15, max_iter=300, hidden (512,128), alpha=3e-2, early_stopping with validation_fraction=0.15, 5 seeds. A smaller learning rate with smaller batches may fit better than the defaults.
backlog.title: Adam MLP with a different schedule

backlog.spec: Inside fit_predict, run a 3-fold inner CV on the training set, with folds grouped by Murcko scaffold via GroupKFold, to get out-of-fold RF and MLP predictions. Pick the blend weight w from {0.2,0.35,0.5,0.65,0.8} that maximizes inner AUROC. Then fit on all training data and blend the test ranks with w. Watch the runtime and use 2 MLP seeds in the inner loop.
backlog.title: Rank blend with weights tuned by inner CV

incumbent.description: Blend RF with a 5-seed sklearn MLP on quantile-transformed features by rank averaging.

memo: Helped: only big moves. Morgan+RF (0.1361) to quantile-transformed descriptors with SVC (0.1282/0.1277); adding the Gobbi pharmacophore fingerprint (0.1072); rank-blending RF with a 5-seed MLP (0.0926, incumbent). Nearly everything since was within noise (sd about 0.0049): XGBoost 0.0923, LightGBM 0.0903, CatBoost 0.0907, Tanimoto SVC 0.0909, MACCS 0.0914, log1p Morgan counts 0.0900. Worse: logistic regression 0.1037, FCFP 0.0967, stacking 0.0966, caching 0.0941, MQN/Gasteiger 0.0939, Morgan replacing Gobbi 0.0969, dropping Gobbi 0.0976, varied MLPs 0.0945. ExtraTrees replacing RF gave 0.0890 once, but other variants gave 0.0972, 0.0973 and 0.0947, so it is fragile. Several slots were wasted on aborted repeat ideas and 5 crashed (likely time or memory); check the history before proposing, and keep runtime under 10 minutes. Next: replicate ExtraTrees 0.0890 once; if it holds, combine it with log1p Morgan counts (0.0900). Avoid small swaps and untried feature repeats.
